items.text: The pain was unbearable and she only wanted it to stop.
Pain in the ankle told him the joint was loaded past what it could carry, so he shifted weight and checked the swelling.
It hurt, and the hurt is how she found the splinter before it went septic.
Avoid pain at all costs; it is the enemy of a good life.
The window was painted blue last spring.
The burn hurt terribly, but it pulled his hand off the stove in time.
